compatibility_verdict: CONDITIONAL GO for transaction-payload phishing detection; NO-GO for direct training on current SCOPE ProposedAction fields alone.
reason: PTXPhish provides labelled transaction hashes and categories, not a ready numerical feature matrix. SCOPE ProposedAction fields (action_kind, target_address, amount, unlimited_approval, known_contract, requires_user_consent) do not contain enough payload detail to reliably reconstruct PTXPhish features. A reproducible transaction/calldata decoder and feature extractor is needed both at training and inference.
safety: ML is advisory only. Existing deterministic deny rules remain authoritative.
accuracy_note: No model was trained in this audit. Accuracy cannot be estimated from hashes/categories alone, and 98-99% is not guaranteed.
